This table gives the location within this Code of those sections of the 2009 Code,
as updated through August 24, 2021, which are included herein. Sections of the 2009
Code, as updated, not listed herein have been omitted as repealed, superseded, obsolete
or not of a general and permanent nature. For the location of ordinances adopted subsequent
thereto, see the table immediately following this table.
